item.title: Will White House ballroom be named after Charlie Kirk? — Here's what we know
item.description: President Trump is reportedly considering names for the new White House ballroom amid controversy over its cost. While denying plans to name it after himself, he mentioned "Presidential Ballroom" as a possibility. MAGA loyalists are now suggesting naming it after Charlie Kirk, praising his advocacy.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Record-breaking storm alert for Jamaica: Hurricane Melissa may become Jamaica’s deadliest storm ever, officials say
item.description: Hurricane Melissa has rapidly intensified into a Category 1 storm, posing a severe threat to Jamaica with sustained winds of 75 mph and a slow-moving trajectory. Officials urge residents to prepare for catastrophic flooding and landslides as the storm is forecast to strengthen into a major hurricane, potentially reaching Category 4 strength by Monday.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Rich Campbell makes Twitch return with test stream, fans react to comeback
item.description: Former OTK co-founder and Twitch streamer Rich Campbell has returned to the platform after a hiatus due to legal challenges. In a recent test stream, Campbell announced he has secured a job and is now working to establish a streaming schedule, signaling a cautious but hopeful comeback to content creation.

item.title: Nina Lin discusses years of sibling abuse and CPS involvement in viral clip
item.description: A resurfaced video shows content creator Nina Lin admitting to years of severe physical and psychological abuse against her younger brother, leading to Child Protective Services intervention. Lin links her actions to her own childhood trauma, highlighting the lasting impact on her brother, including suicidal thoughts. The confession sparks online debate on accountability and trauma cycles.

item.title: Dubai Miracle Garden offers free entry on your birthday! Here's how to avail this offer
item.description: Dubai Miracle Garden reopened on 29 September 2025, featuring over 150 million blooms across 50+ iconic floral displays. UAE residents enjoy 30% off entry, children have reduced ticket prices, and visitors celebrating their birthday can enter for free with ID. Tickets range from AED 52.5–105 ($14–$28.60). Online bookings do not guarantee the birthday offer; walk-up entry is required.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Nina Lin finally addresses backlash and apologizes after viral clip shows Said trying to escape live stream moment
item.description: Twitch streamers Nina Lin and Zoe Spencer have had their channels suspended after an old livestream resurfaced, showing them twerking on a visibly uncomfortable FaZe Silky's assistant, Said. Lin apologized, admitting she was wrong and that Said was clearly hurt, but faced backlash for the delayed response. Viewers are demanding fair treatment and accountability from Twitch.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: What did Dan Clancy reveal about Twitch’s failure during Emiru’s TwitchCon assault? Sparks fresh concern over streamer safety at events
item.description: Twitch CEO Dan Clancy admitted the platform "failed" after streamer Emiru was assaulted at TwitchCon, taking full responsibility for the incident and a "mismanaged" response. Emiru reported staff inaction and a false initial statement from Twitch. Clancy confirmed a comprehensive review of event safety and security protocols is underway to better protect creators and fans.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

Fact check: Has Germany canceled Christmas markets in 2025?
item.description: Viral social media claims of Germany cancelling all Christmas markets in 2025 are false. While a few smaller markets face cancellations due to rising security costs and local issues, the vast majority, including major ones like Dresden's Striezelmarkt, are proceeding as planned. These sensational claims originate from a dubious online source with AI-generated content.

item.description: Argentina's libertarian president took office in 2023 with promises to turn the highly indebted country around and stabilize the economy. But ahead of Sunday's parliamentary election, his achievements are mixed.

item.title: Does adopting far-right rhetoric help the political center?
item.description: Researchers in Berlin have found centrist parties are allowing far-right parties to dominate political debate by repeating their rhetoric. Chancellor Merz's recent remarks on Germany's "cityscape" are the latest example.

item.title: Why is Iran clinging to its nuclear weapons program?
item.description: Iran's Supreme Leader rejected US President Trump's offer for nuclear talks, citing coercion and predetermined outcomes. Experts warn Iran's confrontational stance and weakened regional influence could lead to war, despite ongoing indirect negotiations with the West and potential prisoner exchanges.

item.title: Dubai’s new floating museum to rise on water in the heart of the city
item.description: Dubai unveils its new floating museum, DUMA, on the waters of Dubai Creek. Designed by renowned architect Tadao Ando, the museum will feature five floors of modern art, a library, cafés, and creative spaces. Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid highlights it as a landmark reflecting Dubai’s culture, heritage, and architectural innovation, joining icons like Burj Khalifa and Burj Al Arab.

Zohran Mamdani’s father tortured LGBTQ+ researcher in Uganda: Report
item.description: New York City mayoral candidate Zohran Mamdani faces renewed scrutiny over his father's past academic disputes in Uganda. Allegations of Mahmood Mamdani's actions against an activist have resurfaced, creating an unwelcome distraction for Zohran's campaign focused on equality. This controversy highlights the intersection of personal history and political ambition.

item.title: ‘Unforeseen factors rising’: Xi sounds alarm – key challenges loom as China sets next five-year plan
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping warned of rising uncertainties as the Communist Party approved its next five-year plan, emphasizing technological innovation and economic restructuring. The blueprint, personally shaped by Xi, aims to strengthen China's domestic market and "real economy" amidst global volatility and domestic headwinds.
